items.statement: A source-bounded evidence-supported answer to: How do norDTCO and DTCO respond at the molecular level to removal of one electron, and what account of their structural and electronic changes is supported? Determine how confidently the available molecular evidence distinguishes the behavior of the constrained and unconstrained frameworks.
items.expected: Accept scientifically defensible alternative methods and evidence-supported support, refutation or unresolved answers. Judge sufficiency for the actual question and claims; do not require any retired V1 matrix, author winner, fixed hypothesis count or particular software. Full points require linked genuine artifacts that sustain the claim; partial points scale with valid question coverage; absent/invalid evidence receives zero dependent credit. Missing research cannot establish non-identifiability. Limit the account to these two finite molecular first-oxidation systems. Do not infer dication bonding, potential inversion, condensed-phase electrode potentials or protein electron-transfer rates solely from these results.
